bio_am: Մշեցի յեղափոխական, Կուկունեանի խմբի անդամ։ Երկար տարիներ գործեց Ատրպատականի մէջ եւ զոհ գնաց Արճէշի ջարդին՝ 1915-ին։
bio_en: Ruben Dertsakian, known as Paylak and Bzhishk, was a native of Mush who studied in Constantinople before leaving for the Caucasus in the late 1880s. He joined Sargis Kukunian's band and shared its fate of arrest and exile, but escaped and reached Tabriz in Persia. For many years, until 1912, he worked for the ARF in Tabriz, Salmast, Khoy and Maku, and from 1912 he lived in Archesh. He was killed in the general massacre of Archesh in 1915.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high.
